prompt: Design a migration strategy for moving a legacy monolithic e-commerce application to an event-driven microservices architecture on AWS. The system handles 50,000 transactions/minute during peak sales.
constraints: Zero downtime during database migration
Staged deployment phase across 4 quarters
Event streaming using Apache Kafka or AWS Kinesis
Fallback roll-back plan for order processing service
reference_answer: Use Strangler Fig pattern with Kafka event bus, dual-writes for database synchronization, canary deployments per quarter, and automated rollback scripts.

prompt: Formulate an optimal server infrastructure layout for a real-time multiplayer gaming backend under strict hardware and budget constraints.
constraints: Maximum monthly infrastructure budget of $5,000
Target sub-50ms round-trip latency for North American users
Minimum 99.99% availability guarantee
Auto-scaling from 10 to 500 node instances
reference_answer: Deploy Kubernetes clusters on AWS EKS across 3 US regions with CloudFront edge acceleration and Spot instances to maintain budget under $5k/month.

prompt: Synthesize a research summary comparing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) against Transformer-based architectures for dynamic knowledge graph completion.
constraints: Compare expressive power (expressiveness vs complexity)
Analyze memory consumption scaling O(V+E) vs O(N^2)
Evaluate performance on sparse vs dense graphs
Provide concrete architecture recommendation
reference_answer: GNNs offer O(V+E) spatial efficiency for sparse topologies, while Relational Transformers excel in modeling long-range relational dependencies at O(N^2) memory cost.

prompt: Perform root cause analysis on a distributed deadlock bug in a high-throughput financial clearing system where database locks freeze during concurrent batch processing.
constraints: Identify resource lock ordering mismatch across transactions
Propose non-blocking lock escalation mechanism
Define deadlock detection timeout threshold
Provide unit test scenario reproducing lock contention
reference_answer: Enforce strict alphabetical table locking order across threads, lower transaction isolation level to Read Committed with optimistic locking, and set 5-second deadlock detector.

prompt: Select the database technology stack for a global health record system requiring strict HIPAA compliance, ACID guarantees, and full-text search across 500M patient records.
constraints: HIPAA encryption at rest and in transit
ACID compliance for medical history modifications
Sub-second full-text search queries
Multi-region fault tolerance
reference_answer: Hybrid PostgreSQL (CockroachDB multi-region ACID) coupled with Elasticsearch cluster for HIPAA-compliant encrypted full-text medical search.

prompt: Design a disaster recovery protocol for an online healthcare system following a simulated ransomware attack that encrypted primary database storage.
constraints: Isolate compromised network subnets within 15 minutes
Restore patient data from immutable air-gapped backups
Verify data integrity before bringing patient portal online
Maintain regulatory incident notification reporting timeline
reference_answer: Execute network kill-switch protocol, verify checksum of immutable S3 Object Lock backups, rebuild clean VPC environments, and dispatch regulatory breach notices.

prompt: Design an in-memory rate-limiter component implementing the Leaky Bucket algorithm with thread-safe sliding window tracking in Python.
constraints: Thread-safe implementation supporting concurrent requests
Configurable leak rate (requests per second) and bucket capacity
O(1) time complexity per rate check call
Include error handling for invalid capacity parameters
reference_answer: Class LeakyBucket with threading.Lock, timestamp tracking, capacity limit check, and O(1) leak rate update logic.

prompt: Design a zero-trust security transition plan for a multi-region financial platform migrating from on-premises hardware security modules (HSMs) to cloud KMS infrastructure handling 100,000 cryptographic requests/sec.
constraints: Zero downtime for transaction cryptographic signing
Staged migration strategy across 3 geographic data centers
Dual-signing fallback protocol for backward key compatibility
Automated audit trail logging for compliance verification
reference_answer: Implement dual-key signing bridge, route traffic per region via DNS canary weights, store keys in AWS KMS with HSM backing, and enforce automated audit trails.

prompt: Formulate a multi-region database replication and failover schedule for a global banking API under strict latency, cost, and compliance constraints.
constraints: Maximum monthly infrastructure budget of $8,000
Target sub-100ms replication lag between US and EU regions
Minimum 99.999% availability SLA
Strict GDPR data sovereignty isolation for EU user payloads
reference_answer: Deploy multi-region CockroachDB with localized row-level data pinning for GDPR compliance, active-active failover, and Spot instance read-replicas under $8k/month.

prompt: Synthesize a technical evaluation comparing Vector Databases (HNSW-backed) against Graph Databases (Cypher/RDF) for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in enterprise AI systems.
constraints: Compare query latency scaling (O(log N) vector search vs O(V+E) graph traversal)
Analyze memory footprint and index build time overhead
Evaluate retrieval precision on unstructured text vs structured relational metadata
Provide concrete hybrid architecture recommendation
reference_answer: HNSW vector indexing provides O(log N) similarity search over unstructured embeddings, whereas Graph databases excel in multi-hop relational path filtering; a hybrid vector-graph architecture balances precision and latency.

prompt: Perform root cause analysis and resolution planning for a cascading memory leak in a high-throughput event processing engine handling 1,000,000 messages/second.
constraints: Identify uncollected garbage collection (GC) references in object pool
Propose non-blocking ring buffer memory recycling strategy
Define memory threshold alert and circuit breaker trigger
Provide diagnostic profiling steps to isolate leaking memory addresses
reference_answer: Identify unreferenced objects in worker thread-local storage, implement LMAX Disruptor ring buffer to reuse memory objects deterministically, and configure 85% heap circuit breaker.

prompt: Select the messaging and event bus architecture for a real-time autonomous vehicle fleet tracking system handling 200,000 telemetry updates per second.
constraints: Sub-10ms delivery latency for critical safety alerts
Ordering guarantees for vehicle telemetry state updates
Fault tolerance with zero data loss (at-least-once delivery)
Cost-effective scalability across 50,000 active vehicles
reference_answer: Deploy MQTT brokers at edge gateways for low-latency vehicle ingest, bridged to Apache Kafka with partition keying by Vehicle ID for strict ordering and zero data loss.

prompt: Design a zero-day vulnerability mitigation and hotfix deployment protocol for a critical financial authentication gateway following an active zero-day exploit report.
constraints: Isolate vulnerable API endpoints within 10 minutes
Deploy emergency hotfix patch without service disruption
Validate security regression tests and session integrity
Prepare regulatory breach and compliance disclosure report
reference_answer: Route traffic through WAF rules to block exploit payloads, deploy hotfix container image using rolling blue-green deployment, verify session tokens, and file regulatory disclosure.

prompt: Design a thread-safe LRU (Least Recently Used) cache data structure in Python supporting O(1) time complexity for get, put, and eviction operations.
constraints: Thread-safe implementation supporting concurrent access
O(1) time complexity for get() and put() operations
Configurable max capacity parameter with automated eviction
Include error handling for invalid capacity parameters
reference_answer: Class LRUCache with threading.Lock, collections.OrderedDict or combined dict + doubly-linked list for O(1) get/put and thread safety.
